title: CityGML Energy Input (schema_version 2)
description: JSON input format for the XSD-driven CityGML + Energy ADE generation pipeline. Feature properties mirror xsdata field names and are validated at runtime against the generated bindings, not by this schema.

coordinate_origin.description: Optional XYZ offset added to all imported STEP coordinates.

construction_mapping.description: Maps boundary surface and opening types (and optionally specific gml:ids) to construction feature IDs from a LayeredConstructionLibrary.

by_type.description: Default construction ID per surface/opening type name (e.g. WallSurface, RoofSurface, GroundSurface, Door, Window).

by_id.description: Per-surface/opening overrides keyed by gml:id. Takes precedence over by_type.

type.description: Qualified element name, e.g. 'bldg:Building' or 'nrg3:Energy'. Must match a class in the xsdata-generated bindings.

id.description: gml:id for this feature. Must be unique across all features.

parent.description: gml:id of the parent feature this should be attached to.

parent_field.description: Explicit field name on the parent to attach to (e.g. 'heating_schedule'). Only needed when auto-discovery is ambiguous.

path.description: Path to the STEP file (relative to this JSON file or absolute).
